title: Why Was the Empty Station Bell Ringing?
audience_intent: Original short fantasy mystery for teens and adults; classify the actual finished edit before any publication.
narration: The station bell rang at midnight. The last train had left hours ago. I followed the tapping beneath the platform. A little maintenance robot was hitting the bell with a wrench. Its battery was almost dead. It was calling for help. I connected the charger. Next morning, the same bell rang when I passed. This time, I waved back.
narration_paragraphs: The station bell rang at midnight. The last train had left hours ago. I followed the tapping beneath the platform.
A little maintenance robot was hitting the bell with a wrench. Its battery was almost dead. It was calling for help.
I connected the charger. Next morning, the same bell rang when I passed. This time, I waved back.
